sourceSubject: Merged PR 19798: fix: #37882 enhance input handling in digital hours forms and optimize value change subscriptions

requirements.behavior: Debounce prescribed-hours edits via input handler and guard stacked modals
requirements.rationale: ACT and SAT digital hours forms already use onPrescribedInput/onChangeValue timeouts, committed-value short-circuit, hasOpenModals guards, and confirmedValue setValue(emitEvent:false).
requirements.impact: Prescribed hour edits debounce correctly and avoid duplicate confirmation modals.
